definitions.explanation: A sign or marker that shows the way, either literally on a road or figuratively as guidance in life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{道|みち}しるべ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a signpost on the mountain path.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道|みち}しるべになった。
examples.english: My teacher's words became a guidepost for my life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道|みち}しるべ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{旅人|たびびと}→旅人：12725_tabibito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}していた→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: An old stone signpost was showing travelers the direction.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (road, path) + しるべ (guide, marker) = road marker, guidepost

WRITING:
Can be written as ⟦{道標|みちしるべ}→道標：14385_michishirube⟧. The mixed writing {道|みち}しるべ is also common.

USAGE:
Often used figuratively to mean a guide or guiding principle in life, career, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道|みち}しるべ: a guidepost for life
- {道|みち}しるべ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as a guide
- {道|みち}しるべ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow the signpost
